Builds real-time bidding (OpenRTB) and ad-tracking backends with Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, Go, ClickHouse and MongoDB at Adfinix. Google Summer of Code 2025 contributor (IOOS, pyOBIS). Open-source contributor with merged PRs in Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, Kombu, Scrapy and DRF-extensions. Web scraping and automation developer. Competitive programmer in C++ (1,750+ problems solved on Codeforces). Online Python and programming tutor since 2022.

## Work experience
- Adfinix, Software Engineer (Jul 2024 to present): built the Adsloft backend from scratch (SaaS tracking DSP/SSP clicks, impressions and views with real-time reports for advertisers and publishers) and the Aifinix backend (scalable APIs, auth, analytics pipelines). OpenRTB real-time bidding flows and a mock server to test DSP/SSP request-response interactions. CPM ads, frequency capping, rich media ads. End-to-end analytical dashboards. Upgraded the platform from Django 3.2 to 5.1. ClickHouse and MongoDB for high-volume event data. Slack automation bot. Next.js marketing site. Stack: Django, DRF, ClickHouse, MongoDB, Next.js, OpenRTB, Docker, Jenkins.
- Google Summer of Code 2025, Contributor at IOOS (May to Jul 2025): HTTP-level caching in the pyOBIS Python package with requests-cache, cross-platform cache paths, tests and docs, all merged upstream. Seagrass habitat analysis combining OBIS and GBIF data with One-Class SVM anomaly detection and Species Distribution Modeling. Keynote speaker and workshop instructor at Hacking Limnology 2025.
- Online Python Trainer, freelance (Nov 2022 to present): teaches Python from beginner to intermediate, debugging, data structures and algorithms, with weekly exams and coding challenges.
- TrendBreaker, Trainee Software Developer (Apr 2022 to May 2024): PyQt5 desktop app, React Native mobile app with a Django backend, data analysis.

## Projects
- [GoRTB](https://github.com/MehrazRumman/gortb): full OpenRTB 2.5 implementation in Go with type-safe bid request/response structs, recursive validation with sentinel errors and wire-format JSON. Standard library only.
- [fastapi-observer](https://github.com/MehrazRumman/fastapi-observer): structured logging and observability middleware for FastAPI with pluggable storage (memory, JSON, SQLite) and a built-in event dashboard. On PyPI as fastapi-inspector.
- [python-web-scraping-automation](https://github.com/MehrazRumman/python-web-scraping-automation): Python web scraping examples with requests + BeautifulSoup, Playwright and Scrapy, with tests and CI.
- CV Generator: browser-based CV, Europass, biodata and academic CV builder with 42 templates, live PDF preview, ATS-readable text and correct Bangla shaping (Next.js, react-pdf, Zod).
- Adsloft and Aifinix (Adfinix): AdTech SaaS backends for DSP/SSP tracking, real-time reporting and analytics.
- Seagrass Habitat Analysis and pyOBIS Workshop Notebook: marine ecological modeling with OBIS data (scikit-learn, xarray, SDM).
- KachaMorich: e-commerce app with payments, accounts and admin management (Django, React, PostgreSQL).
- DSP with Fast Fourier Transform: signal processing study in Python and NumPy.

## Web scraping and automation
- Car listings: scraped 3,700+ car listings with full specs and photos for a marketplace client, normalised and deduplicated.
- Fight results database: event, bout and fighter results from 7 sources across boxing, Muay Thai, kickboxing, bare-knuckle and jiu-jitsu, unified into one schema.
- Medicines catalogue: drug names, generics, manufacturers, dosage forms and prices from pharmacy and regulator sites.
- Tools: Python, Scrapy, Playwright, requests, BeautifulSoup, image pipelines, deduplication, Slack bots, workflow automation.

## Data analysis (Bangladesh public data)
- [Bangladesh Road Accidents 2021 to 2026](https://github.com/MehrazRumman/BD-Road-Accident): Road Safety Foundation and BRTA reports transcribed from scanned PDFs and analysed, with an interactive Bangla map of 64 districts and 215 accident-prone highway spots. Example finding: 7,359 road deaths in 2025, 36% on motorcycles.
- [Dengue in Bangladesh 2000 to 2026](https://github.com/MehrazRumman/dengue-analysis): DGHS surveillance, census and climate data combined into hotspot maps, case fatality rates, seasonality and temperature-lag correlations.
